{"metadata":{"description":"Per-provider API key rotation for DeepSeek Harness: key pools, automatic 429 rate-limit failover, cooldown probing & Settings UI","id":"gh:1338166081","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-key-rotation","slug":"GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-key-rotation","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-provider API key rotation for DeepSeek Harness: key pools, automatic 429 rate-limit failover, co"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"oldown probing & Settings UI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-key-rotation"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Enterprise-Grade Transparent API Key Rotation, Rate-Limit Pre-emption & Failover Cascade for DeepSee"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"e-Grade Transparent API Key Rotation, Rate-Limit Pre-emption & Failover Cascade for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🇬🇧 English •
🇷🇺 Русский •
🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.8.11 (One-click Updater & Quality Gate)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Plugin updater in Settings**: see current/latest version and update from the card without leavin"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"g DSH (`#307`).
- **Safer best-effort side effects**: intentional non-critical failures log at debug"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" instead of silent empty `catch` (`#315`).
- **Theme-only client colors** and production-path test c"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"leanup (`#311`, `#314`).
- **Leaner publication set**: agent-only files no longer ship in git/npm (`"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"(`#311`, `#314`).
- **Leaner publication set**: agent-only files no longer ship in git/npm (`#308`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.8.10 (Stream Concurrency Hardening & Auto-Pruning)
- **Zero Concurrency Leaks"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"**: Guaranteed release of stream concurrency slots via deterministic `try ... finally` block, preven"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ting key starvation during clean finishes or client stream aborts.
- **Robust Probe Retry**: Added t"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ransient network socket error retry (`PROBE_RETRY_DELAY_MS`) in `SandboxRunner.probeModels` before m"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"arking keys as broken.
- **Memory & State Pruning**: Automated pruning of removed/stale keys from in"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ternal pool maps during periodic sweep cycles."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.8.9 (Routing Evolution & UI)
- **Proactive Rate-Limit Guard**: Automatic key "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"pausing based on `x-ratelimit-remaining-*` and `Retry-After` headers before hitting 429 errors.
- **"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"Self-Healing / Auto-Unbreak**: Periodic background probe via free `/models` endpoint to automaticall"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"y revive broken keys without token burn.
- **Latency-Aware Routing**: Selectable strategies: `round-"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"robin`, `least-loaded` (concurrency), and `lowest-latency` (p95 latency).
- **UI Evolution in `dsh-c"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"linebot` Style**: Sequential batch "Test All Keys" runner with live progress, Live Event Stream draw"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"er, and Quota Reset countdown badge.
- **Native Dual Language Support**: Native English (`en`) and C"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"hinese (`zh`) UI dictionaries."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 🛠️ What's New in v0.8.0 (Stability)
- **🔌 Circuit breaker**: after N consecutive provider failur"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"es the circuit opens and requests fail fast (`CIRCUIT_OPEN`) until a cool-down; half-open probes rec"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"over automatically.
- **🕒 Monotonic clock**: cooldown/breaker durations use process monotonic time s"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"o NTP steps cannot invert remaining times.
- **📮 Non-blocking webhooks**: alerts go through a bounde"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"d queue with backoff — stream rotation never waits on webhook HTTP.
- **🧱 Atomic I/O helpers**: cras"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"h-safe writes; corrupt JSON never overwrites previous in-memory state.
- **🧹 Clone-route GC**: orpha"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ned auto-created clone routes are dropped from the runtime set.
- **🧭 Error taxonomy**: explicit swi"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"tch/surface/soft classification for 408/425/429/5xx, sockets and gRPC codes.
- **📡 Status extras**: "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"per-provider `circuit` plus `meta.expectedClones` / `meta.notifyQueue`.
- **🧪 Smoke harness**: scrip"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ted 429 → next-key → success path in `test/smoke-rotation-080.test.mjs`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.8.67
- **📥 Full Pool Config Export & Import (#504)**: Masked export for safe "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"sharing, full backup export with AES-256-GCM encryption (PBKDF2), diff preview mode, and import with"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" merge/replace strategies.
- **⚡ Quick Actions in Chat Header Popover (#499)**: Instant key manageme"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"nt directly from the conversation toolbar — skip to next key, reset cooldowns, or pause problematic "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"keys via `/dsh-key-rotation/quick-action`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 🚀 What's New in v0.8.66
- **⏳ Dynamic Reset Scheduler (#498)**: Reads upstream `retry-after` and"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" `x-ratelimit-reset-*` headers to set exact cooldowns (+250ms safety jitter) and schedules immediate"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" unref wake-up timers when the upstream reset window rolls over.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 🔒 Security & Safe Storage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"* **Zero Plaintext Secrets in Plugin Config**: Configuration files store only environment variable r"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"eference names (e.g. `MY_PROVIDER_API_KEY`).
* **Secure Vault Storage**: Actual secret values reside"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" securely in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` managed by the DSH `Credentials` service.
* **5-Character"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" Masking (`keyTail`)**: Full secret values are never sent to the client browser; only the trailing 5"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" characters are exposed for visual identification. Short keys (<= 5 characters) return a fixed maske"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"d placeholder (`***`) to prevent credential disclosure.
* **Fail-Closed Loopback, Same-Origin & Writ"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"e-Origin Guard**: Administrative endpoints strictly enforce loopback checks (`isTrustedBridgeRequest"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"`): the socket peer and the `Host` header must both be loopback (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`, `localhost`), a"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"nd `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` is always refused. An attached `Origin` must be an http(s) loopback "},{"id":"p16s10","text":"origin matching `Host` exactly. `Origin` is required on mutating methods (`POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELE"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"TE`) — requests without `Origin` pass only if they carry positive Desktop shell identification (`@de"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"epseek-ai/dsh-desktop/` in `User-Agent` AND `dsh-auth-` session cookie) or a same-origin `Referer`. "},{"id":"p16s13","text":"`GET`/`HEAD`/`OPTIONS` remain unrestricted as browsers omit `Origin` on same-origin reads.
* **Fail-"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"Closed Resolver on Pool Exhaustion**: When all credentials in a managed pool are exhausted, paused, "},{"id":"p16s15","text":"expired, or blocked by RPM/TPM limits, the resolver fails closed with `LOCAL_POOL_EXHAUSTED` error r"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"ather than falling back to leaking unmanaged credentials.
* **SSRF Protection & Rebinding Guard**: R"},{"id":"p16s17","text":"emote provider pool import strictly enforces HTTPS-only URLs, validates all resolved IP addresses in"},{"id":"p16s18","text":"cluding IPv4-mapped and IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses (`::ffff:127.0.0.1`, `::ffff:7f00:1`, `64:ff9"},{"id":"p16s19","text":"b::/96`), and enforces connect-time DNS validation via undici agent dispatchers to prevent TOCTOU DN"},{"id":"p16s20","text":"S rebinding.
* **Cross-Pool Revocation & Inheritance**: Model pools automatically inherit pause, rev"},{"id":"p16s21","text":"oke, and expiry states from their base provider; runtime 401 permanent authentication failures revok"},{"id":"p16s22","text":"e the credential across all shared pools immediately."}],"truncated":true}
